about_short_description.short_description: Workpay is a Payroll, Benefits, Compliance & embed finance for local and remote teams in Africa.

product.name: Payroll Software
product.description: Automates payroll calculations, tax compliance, and salary disbursements across multiple African countries in local currencies.

product.name: HR Management Software
product.description: Manages employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, leave, performance, and offboarding on a unified platform.

product.name: Employer of Record (EOR) Services
product.description: Enables companies to legally hire, manage, and pay remote employees across Africa without establishing local entities.

product.name: Outsourced Payroll Services
product.description: Delegates payroll processing and compliance management to Workpay’s experts for accurate, timely, and compliant payroll across Africa.

product.name: Time and Attendance Management
product.description: Tracks employee working hours, shifts, and schedules with automated workflows accessible remotely for accurate attendance management.

product.name: Employee Benefits and Perks Administration
product.description: Manages employee benefits including health insurance, savings plans, early wage access, and discounted services.
